local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Safe ScreenGui Parent
local function getSafeParent()
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return gethui and gethui() or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    end)
    if success and result then
        return result
    end
    return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local ParentContainer = getSafeParent()

-- Cleanup Old Instances
if ParentContainer:FindFirstChild("SpinDashSelectionGui") then
    ParentContainer.SpinDashSelectionGui:Destroy()
end
if ParentContainer:FindFirstChild("SpinDashMainGui") then
    ParentContainer.SpinDashMainGui:Destroy()
end

-- ========================================================
-- 1. DEVICE SELECTION GUI
-- ========================================================
local SelectionGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SelectionGui.Name = "SpinDashSelectionGui"
SelectionGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

local function applyMode(isPhone)
    if isPhone then
        DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 35)
        DashButton.TextSize = 12
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0.75, -17)
    else
        DashButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 48)
        DashButton.TextSize = 16
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -65, 0.75, -24)
    end
    SelectionGui:Destroy()
    MainGui.Enabled = true
end

PhoneBtn.Activated:Connect(function() applyMode(true) end)
TabletBtn.Activated:Connect(function() applyMode(false) end)

-- Mobile & PC Draggable Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

DashButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = DashButton.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

DashButton.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        DashButton.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- ========================================================

local animR6 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR6.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://278828913"

local animR15 = Instance.new("Animation")
animR15.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://582855105"

local function performSpinDash()
    if isDashing then return end
    
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    if not humanoid or not root then return end
    
    isDashing = true
    
    -- Load Animation safely
    local animTrack
    pcall(function()
        local animToPlay = (humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6) and animR6 or animR15
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
        animTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(animToPlay)
        animTrack:Play()
    end)
    
    -- Physics Setup
    local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
    attachment.Parent = root
    
    local linearVel = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
    linearVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    linearVel.MaxForce = 999999
    linearVel.VectorVelocity = root.CFrame.LookVector * 60
    linearVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    linearVel.Parent = root
    
    local angularVel = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
    angularVel.Attachment0 = attachment
    angularVel.MaxTorque = 999999
    angularVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
    angularVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
    angularVel.Parent = root
    
    task.wait(0.5)
    
    linearVel:Destroy()
    angularVel:Destroy()
    attachment:Destroy()
    
    if animTrack then
        pcall(function()
            animTrack:Stop()
            animTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end
    
    isDashing = false
end

DashButton.Activated:Connect(performSpinDash)

scripts.script:
-- Скрипт полёта с красивым синим огнём
-- Создаёт эффект синего пламени при полёте

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Настройки
local Settings = {
    FlySpeed = 50,
    ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.F,  -- Клавиша для включения/выключения
    FireSize = 5,
    FireColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255),
    FireTransparency = 0.3,
    TrailEnabled = true
}

-- Переменные
local isFlying = false
local flyConnection = nil
local fireEffects = {}
local trailEffect = nil

-- Функция создания огня
local function createFire(parent, position)
    local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
    fire.Size = Settings.FireSize
    fire.Color = Settings.FireColor
    fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)
    fire.Heat = 15
    fire.Parent = parent
    
    return fire
end

-- Функция создания эффекта следа
local function createTrail()
    local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
    trail.Color = Color3.new(0, 0.6, 1)
    trail.Lifetime = 1
    trail.MinLength = 1
    trail.MaxLength = 10
    trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)
    trail.Parent = rootPart
    return trail
end

-- Функция создания эффектов полёта
local function createFlyEffects()
    -- Огонь на ногах
    local leftFoot = character:FindFirstChild("LeftFoot")
    local rightFoot = character:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
    
    if leftFoot then
        local fire = createFire(leftFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    if rightFoot then
        local fire = createFire(rightFoot, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0))
        table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    end
    
    -- Огонь под персонажем
    local groundFire = Instance.new("Part")
    groundFire.Name = "FlyFirePart"
    groundFire.Size = Vector3.new(3, 0.5, 3)
    groundFire.Transparency = 0
    groundFire.CanCollide = false
    groundFire.Anchored = true
    groundFire.Parent = character
    
    local fire = createFire(groundFire, Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))
    table.insert(fireEffects, fire)
    
    -- След
    if Settings.TrailEnabled then
        trailEffect = createTrail()
    end
end

-- Функция удаления эффектов
local function removeFlyEffects()
    for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
        if fire and fire.Parent then
            fire:Destroy()
        end
    end
    fireEffects = {}
    
    if trailEffect then
        trailEffect:Destroy()
        trailEffect = nil
    end
    
    local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
    if groundFire then
        groundFire:Destroy()
    end
end

-- Функция включения полёта
local function startFly()
    if isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = true
    createFlyEffects()
    
    -- Включаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, false)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, false)
    
    -- Управление полётом
    flyConnection = game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if not isFlying then return end
        
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local moveDirection = Vector3.new()
        
        -- Получаем ввод
        local keyboard = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.LookVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + camera.CFrame.RightVector
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if keyboard:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        
        -- Нормализуем направление
        if moveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDirection = moveDirection.Unit * Settings.FlySpeed * deltaTime
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + moveDirection
        end
        
        -- Обновляем позицию огня
        local groundFire = character:FindFirstChild("FlyFirePart")
        if groundFire then
            groundFire.CFrame = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -2, 0))
        end
        
        -- Анимация огня
        for _, fire in ipairs(fireEffects) do
            if fire and fire.Parent then
                fire.Size = Settings.FireSize + math.sin(tick() * 5) * 0.5
            end
        end
    end)
    
    -- Визуальный эффект запуска
    local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
    particles.Name = "FlyParticles"
    particles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Settings.FireColor)
    particles.Size = NumberSequence.new(1, 3)
    particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
    particles.Rate = 50
    particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
    particles.Parent = rootPart
    
    -- Эффект свечения
    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Color = Settings.FireColor
    pointLight.Brightness = 5
    pointLight.Range = 15
    pointLight.Parent = rootPart
    pointLight.Name = "FlyLight"
    
    print("Полёт включён! Используйте WASD для движения, Space - вверх, Shift - вниз")
end

-- Функция выключения полёта
local function stopFly()
    if not isFlying then return end
    
    isFlying = false
    
    -- Отключаем невесомость
    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Falling, true)
    humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping, true)
    
    -- Удаляем эффекты
    if flyConnection then
        flyConnection:Disconnect()
        flyConnection = nil
    end
    
    removeFlyEffects()
    
    -- Удаляем частицы и свет
    local particles = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyParticles")
    if particles then
        particles:Destroy()
    end
    
    local light = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyLight")
    if light then
        light:Destroy()
    end
    
    print("Полёт выключен")
end

-- Переключение полёта
local function toggleFly()
    if isFlying then
        stopFly()
    else
        startFly()
    end
end

-- Обработка нажатия клавиши
game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Settings.ToggleKey then
        toggleFly()
    end
end)

-- GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player.PlayerGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.9, -50)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 40)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "✨ Полёт с Огнём ✨"
title.TextColor3 = Settings.FireColor
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 16
title.Parent = mainFrame

local statusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
statusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
statusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.3, 0)
statusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
statusLabel.Text = "Статус: Выключен"
statusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
statusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
statusLabel.TextSize = 14
statusLabel.Parent = mainFrame

local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 30)

toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200)

	end

	local hdadmin = replicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("HDAdminHDClient")
	if hdadmin and hdadmin:FindFirstChild("Signals") then

		if request then

		end
	end
	return false
end

scripts.script:
if game.PlaceId == 17625359962 then
    local OrionLib = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jensonhirst/Orion/c8db6d194077f39a806c645243d359187b9b4370/source"))()
    local Window = OrionLib:MakeWindow({Name = "ColdTeam X Rivals", HidePremium = false, SaveConfig = true, IntroEnabled = false})

    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
    local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local ChamsColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    local NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local MaxDistance = 500
    local NameSize = 40

    local AimOn = false
    local AimFOV = 100
    local AimSmooth = 0.2
    local AimPart = "Head"
    local AimKey = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
    local AimMaxRange = 1000
    local AimWallCheck = true

    local WeatherOn = false
    local CurrentWeather = "Rain"
    local WeatherObjects = {}
    local WeatherConnections = {}
    local WeatherThreads = {}

    local InfJumpOn = false
    local InfJumpConnection = nil

    local SpeedOn = false
    local SpeedValue = 60
    local SpeedConnection = nil

    local BoxOn = false
    local BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    local HealthOn = false
    local BoxData = {}

    local function getRoot()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local function createPuddle(position)
        local puddle = Instance.new("Part")
        puddle.Name = "WeatherPuddle"
        puddle.Size = Vector3.new(math.random(5, 10), 0.05, math.random(5, 10))
        puddle.Position = position + Vector3.new(0, 0.02, 0)
        puddle.Transparency = 0.25
        puddle.Reflectance = 0.35
        puddle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 110, 150)
        puddle.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
        puddle.Anchored = true
        puddle.CanCollide = false
        puddle.Parent = workspace

        task.spawn(function()
            for i = 1, 15 do
                if not puddle.Parent then return end
                puddle.Transparency = 0.25 + (i * 0.05)
                task.wait(0.3)
            end
            if puddle.Parent then
                puddle:Destroy()
            end
        end)
    end

    local function createLightning()
        if not WeatherOn then return end

        local originalBrightness = Lighting.Brightness
        local originalAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
        local originalFogColor = Lighting.FogColor

        TweenService:Create(
            Lighting,
            TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Brightness = 3, OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)}
        ):Play()

        task.delay(0.08, function()
            if not WeatherOn then return end
            TweenService:Create(
                Lighting,
                TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Brightness = originalBrightness, OutdoorAmbient = originalAmbient, FogColor = originalFogColor}
            ):Play()
        end)

        task.delay(0.15, function()
            if not WeatherOn then return end
            TweenService:Create(
                Lighting,
                TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                {Brightness = 2.5, OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255), FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)}
            ):Play()

            task.delay(0.4, function()
                if not WeatherOn then return end
                TweenService:Create(
                    Lighting,
                    TweenInfo.new(1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
                    {Brightness = originalBrightness, OutdoorAmbient = originalAmbient, FogColor = originalFogColor}
                ):Play()
            end)
        end)

        local thunder = Instance.new("Sound")
        thunder.Name = "ThunderSound"
        thunder.SoundId = "rbxassetid://131237241"
        thunder.Volume = 1
        thunder.Parent = workspace
        thunder:Play()
        Debris:AddItem(thunder, 6)
    end

    local function createRainbowFlash()
        if not WeatherOn then return end

        local hue = math.random() * 360
        local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue / 360, 0.6, 1)

        local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("WeatherColor")
        if cc then
            local originalTint = cc.TintColor
            cc.TintColor = color

            task.delay(0.3, function()
                if cc.Parent then
                    TweenService:Create(
                        cc,
                        TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
                        {TintColor = originalTint}
                    ):Play()
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    local function applyLighting(preset)
        WeatherObjects.originalLighting = {
            Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
            OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
            FogColor = Lighting.FogColor,
            FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
            FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
            EnvironmentDiffuseScale = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
            EnvironmentSpecularScale = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale
        }

        TweenService:Create(
            Lighting,
            TweenInfo.new(3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
            preset
        ):Play()
    end

    local function createEffects(preset)
        local blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
        blur.Name = "WeatherBlur"
        blur.Size = 0
        blur.Parent = Lighting
        TweenService:Create(
            blur,
            TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Size = preset.blur}
        ):Play()

        local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
        cc.Name = "WeatherColor"
        cc.Brightness = 0
        cc.Contrast = 0
        cc.Saturation = 0
        cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        cc.Parent = Lighting
        TweenService:Create(
            cc,
            TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {
                Contrast = preset.contrast,
                Saturation = preset.saturation,
                TintColor = preset.tint
            }
        ):Play()

        local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
        bloom.Name = "WeatherBloom"
        bloom.Intensity = 0
        bloom.Size = 10
        bloom.Threshold = 0.7
        bloom.Parent = Lighting
        TweenService:Create(
            bloom,
            TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
            {Intensity = preset.bloom}
        ):Play()
    end

    local function startRain()
        if WeatherOn then return end
        WeatherOn = true

        WeatherObjects.parts = {}
        WeatherObjects.winds = {}

        for i = 1, 6 do
            local area = Instance.new("Part")
            area.Name = "WeatherArea" .. i
            area.Size = Vector3.new(200, 120, 200)
            area.Transparency = 1
            area.CanCollide = false
            area.Anchored = true

            local root = getRoot()
            if root then
                area.Position = root.Position + Vector3.new(
                    math.random(-100, 100), 40, math.random(-100, 100)
                )
            else
                area.Position = Vector3.new(0, 40, 0)
            end
            area.Parent = workspace

            local drops = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
            drops.Texture = "rbxassetid://241876428"
            drops.Rate = 300
            drops.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 1.5)
            drops.Speed = NumberRange.new(30, 50)
            drops.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
            drops.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(0, 0)
            drops.VelocitySpread = 30
            drops.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -80, 0)
            drops.LightEmission = 0.3
            drops.LightInfluence = 0.7

            drops.Size = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2)
            })

            drops.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.2),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.1),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.5)
            })

            drops.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(210, 225, 245)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(180, 200, 230))
            })

            drops.Parent = area

            local breeze = Instance.new("VectorForce")
            breeze.Name = "WeatherWind"
            breeze.Force = Vector3.new(math.random(-15, 15), -1, math.random(-15, 15))
            breeze.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
            breeze.Attachment0 = Instance.new("Attachment", area)
            breeze.Parent = area

            table.insert(WeatherObjects.parts, area)
            table.insert(WeatherObjects.winds, breeze)
        end

        applyLighting({
            Brightness = 0.7,
            OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 120, 140),
            FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(130, 145, 165),
            FogStart = 40,
            FogEnd = 1000,
            EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.7,
            EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.4
        })

        createEffects({
            blur = 1.5,
            contrast = 0.15,
            saturation = -0.05,
            tint = Color3.fromRGB(190, 200, 220),
            bloom = 0.2
        })

        local rainSound = Instance.new("Sound")

        local char = plr.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
        return true
    end

    local function isVisible(part)
        if not AimWallCheck then return true end

        local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
        local dir = part.Position - origin

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, Camera}

        local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
        if result then
            return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(part.Parent)
        end
        return true
    end

        local closest = nil
        local shortest = AimFOV
        local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()

                        if onScreen and screenPos.Z > 0 then

                            if dist < shortest and isVisible(part) then

                                closest = part
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return closest

local function startFreeCam()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    stopFreeCam()
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    
    local camPos = camera.CFrame.Position
    local camYaw, camPitch = 0, 0
    
    freeCamConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not freeCamEnabled then return end
        
        --// Обертання камери мишкою (ПК) //
        if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
            local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
            camYaw = camYaw - delta.X * 0.003
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - delta.Y * 0.003, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        
        --// Обертання камери правим джойстиком (мобільні) //
        if fcLookActive and fcLookInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            camYaw = camYaw - fcLookInput.X * 0.05
            camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - fcLookInput.Y * 0.05, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
        
        local rotation = CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(camPitch, 0, 0)
        
        --// Рух камери клавіатурою //
        local moveDir = Vector3.zero
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir += rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir -= rotation.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir -= rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += rotation.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
        
        --// Рух камери лівим джойстиком (мобільні) //
        if fcMoveActive and fcMoveInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
            moveDir += rotation.LookVector * (-fcMoveInput.Y)
            moveDir += rotation.RightVector * fcMoveInput.X
        end
        
        if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
            moveDir = moveDir.Unit
        end
        
        camPos = camPos + moveDir * freeCamSpeed * (1 / 60)
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camPos) * rotation
    end)
end

local function getClosestTargetToCursor()

        if plr ~= player and isEnemy(plr) then

            if char then
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(aimbotTargetPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function updateLeftJoy(inputPos)

    local delta = inputPos - center
    local maxDist = leftJoy.gui.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
    if delta.Magnitude > maxDist then
        delta = delta.Unit * maxDist
    end
    leftJoy.knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X - 30, 0.5, delta.Y - 30)
    fcMoveInput = Vector2.new(delta.X / maxDist, delta.Y / maxDist)
end

    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDir += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveDir -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end

    if joyActive and joyInput.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        moveDir += camera.CFrame.LookVector * (-joyInput.Y)
        moveDir += camera.CFrame.RightVector * joyInput.X
    end

    if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveDir = moveDir.Unit
    end

    local targetVelocity = moveDir * SPEED
    velocity = velocity:Lerp(targetVelocity, SMOOTHNESS)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
    bodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, hrp.Position + camera.CFrame.LookVector)
end)
